blocks.text: Check our Miss Universe 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features. Bea Millan Windorski of the Philippines secured a spot in the 2026 Miss Universe Top 30 during the finals night in Puerto Rico on Nov. 24 (Nov. 25 in the Philippines). The beauty queen-activist advanced to the next round along with the following delegates: Ecuador’s Pazmiño claimed a spot in the next round after she emerged as the People’s Choice awardee. Windorski is hoping to win the 2026 Miss Universe crown to be the Philippines’ fifth Miss Universe titleholder, following Gloria Diaz in 1969, Margie Moran in 1973, […]...
